lines.zh: 我在你屋后的空地上走过。
lines.en: I walk across the empty lot behind your house.
My foot falls without a sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，与你的步频相同。
lines.en: Step for step, I match your pace.
I pass between the trees.

lines.zh: 我的身体像被拉长的影子。
lines.en: My body is like a shadow stretched out.
I reach the well and pause.
Ash falls from my shoulders.
I go around the torches you planted.
The grass lies flat where I step.

lines.zh: 每走三步，我就换个方向。
lines.en: Every three steps I change direction.

lines.zh: 我背对着你，走得很自然。
lines.en: My back is to you and I walk quite naturally.
I stand in the dark outside the window.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，头稍微歪着。
lines.en: I do not move; my head tilts slightly.
I count the breaths inside your house.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在墙上一明一暗。
lines.en: My outline brightens and dims on the wall.
My arms hang at my sides.

lines.zh: 我像一件被人摆好的家具。
lines.en: I am like a piece of furniture someone arranged.
I listen for you turning in bed.

lines.zh: 远处传来我自己的脚步回声。
lines.en: The echo of my own steps comes from far off.
I lift a finger, then lower it.
No one lived here to begin with.

lines.zh: 我静静地站着，等你出来。
lines.en: I stand quietly, waiting for you to come out.

lines.zh: 我的影子比这间屋子还长。
lines.en: My shadow is longer than this house.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是存在。
lines.en: I do nothing at all; I only exist.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，你先住进来的。
lines.en: I was always here; you moved in after.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我就会正对着你。
lines.en: When you turn round, I am facing you.

lines.zh: 我的脸没有表情，你也没有。
lines.en: My face has no expression; neither has yours.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步，其实是我的。
lines.en: Those footsteps you hear are mine.
You are counting how many times I have appeared.

lines.zh: 你门口的土上有我的脚印。
lines.en: There are my prints in the dirt by your door.
I have not yet learned your name.

lines.zh: 我站得离你比昨天近一点。
lines.en: I stand a little nearer than yesterday.
You cannot see me in the mirror.

lines.zh: 你睡觉的时候我才走动。
lines.en: I only walk while you sleep.
You thought it was the wind.

lines.zh: 你的东西被人动过了吧。
lines.en: Your things have been moved, haven't they.

lines.zh: 我数过你的每一样东西。
lines.en: I have counted everything you own.
Good; your ears are pricked.
Do not put out that lamp.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一层空气。
lines.en: Only air stands between us.
Smile, and I will step back a little.
Your shadow just moved.

lines.zh: 你每天都比前一天更警觉。
lines.en: You grow warier each day.
You hit me, but the wound is shallow.
My body closes again.
That left your hand numb.
I step back, as if blown by wind.
I do not cry out, and I do not bleed.
You heard something, didn't you.
You have come a little closer.
This body does not belong to the world.
You still have not driven me out.
The thing you left at the door.
That burning lamp holds my attention.
I creep toward the table.

lines.zh: 这味道是你的，我要记住。
lines.en: This smell is yours; I will remember it.
I reach out to touch it once.
You arrange it neatly; I will disorder it.

lines.zh: 你把门闩插上了，我进不来。
lines.en: You barred the door; I cannot come in.
I go around to the window side.

lines.zh: 这屋里的东西都挪过位置了。
lines.en: Everything in this house has shifted.

lines.zh: 你回头，东西已经不在了。
lines.en: You turn round and the thing is gone.
You walked into me; cold, isn't it.

lines.zh: 这一碰，你身上的汗是冷的。
lines.en: At the touch, the sweat on you goes cold.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来沉很多。
lines.en: My body is far heavier than it looks.
You pull back; I do not follow.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，衣角都没动。
lines.en: We pass each other and not even a hem stirs.

lines.zh: 你伸手推我，手穿过去了。
lines.en: You push at me and your hand passes through.

lines.zh: 撞上之后，你的灯灭了一瞬。
lines.en: After the bump your lamp gutters.
I have no temperature at all.
You press to the wall; so do I.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离不该这么小。
lines.en: The distance between us should not be this small.

lines.zh: 这个东西没有人教过我。
lines.en: No one ever taught me this.

lines.zh: 你屋子里的镜子照不到我。
lines.en: The mirrors in your house do not show me.
That would require someone to be present.
I have only footsteps.

lines.zh: 我歪头，这个动作是学的。
lines.en: I tilt my head; I learned that motion.
I do not come in pairs; I come as a shadow.

lines.zh: 你把这件事说给谁听了。
lines.en: Who have you told about this.
I retreat slowly into the dark.
I leave that question to you.

lines.zh: 我把它拿起来，摆到别处。
lines.en: I pick it up and set it elsewhere.
I hold it and look for a long time.
It still carries your warmth.

lines.zh: 我把它翻过来，印子朝上。
lines.en: I turn it over, the print facing up.
When I put it back, its place has changed.
This thing is missing a corner.

lines.zh: 明天你会发现它不见了。
lines.en: Tomorrow you will find it gone.
It is so light it feels like nothing.
I set down another item.
You have walked in.
I stand on the path you must take.

lines.zh: 你听见了，就说明我成功了。
lines.en: If you heard, then I succeeded.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子只剩我们两个。
lines.en: Only the two of us remain in this house.
I do not chase; I only wait.
Your steps are quickening.
Count to three and I move.
You turn and I am exactly where I was.

lines.zh: 我选你了，从头到尾只选你。
lines.en: I chose you, and only you, from the start.
The door has closed itself.
Listen; the quiet is deeply wrong.
Your lamp does not reach me.
I stand at the end of the corridor.

lines.zh: 你走进厨房，我跟到门口。
lines.en: You enter the kitchen; I stop at the door.
You go up; the stairs creak twice.
I am one step nearer than yesterday.
You hold your breath behind the door.
I lay my hand on the door.

lines.zh: 你从窗口看出去，什么也没有。
lines.en: You look out the window and see nothing.
I am at the other window.
I keep to that rhythm.

lines.zh: 你听见了两次，其实只有一次。
lines.en: You heard it twice; there was only one.
Your hand is feeling for matches.

lines.zh: 我在等你点灯的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you light the lamp.
You dare not look back.
I move along the wall, parallel to you.
The corridor is a little longer than yesterday.
You count the doors and miscount one.
Three more steps and you reach me.
I stop so that you hear me.
At last you begin to run.
My hand comes down on your shoulder.
I close on your throat, lightly.
You break free with a chill left on your skin.

lines.zh: 我抬手的影子先落到你脸上。
lines.en: The shadow of my raised hand lands on your face first.
I lean close to your ear.
You stumble back against the table.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，数着脉。
lines.en: I take your wrist and count the pulse.
You fall; I do not press.
I used only a tenth of my strength.
I let go and withdraw into the shadow.
Did you hear me laugh once?
I wait for you to rise.
The next one will be heavier.

lines.zh: 我第一次出现在你屋外。
lines.en: I appear outside your house for the first time.

lines.zh: 风把你的门吹开了一条缝。
lines.en: The wind opens your door a crack.
I stand just outside that light.

lines.zh: 这一刻开始，你不再是一个人。
lines.en: From this moment, you are no longer alone.

lines.zh: 我的名字显示成一个符号。
lines.en: My name shows only as a symbol.

lines.zh: 地上的草朝一个方向倒。
lines.en: The grass leans one way.
You have noticed nothing yet.
I walk to your well first.
There are new prints in the soil.
The sky begins to darken.
Your dog barks at nothing.

lines.zh: 我不急，我从很远的地方来。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I came a long way.

lines.zh: 屋子里的木头响了一声。
lines.en: A beam in the house creaks.

lines.zh: 我站在你白天晒衣服的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you hung laundry in the day.

lines.zh: 你点起了灯，我退后一步。
lines.en: You light the lamp; I step back once.

lines.zh: 屋檐下有什么东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves under the eaves.
The quiet came too early here.
You heard a single footstep.

lines.zh: 我开始记得你屋子的布局。
lines.en: I am learning the layout of your house.
I will stay here until you grow used to me.
My outline scatters in the firelight.

lines.zh: 我落下去，落地没有声音。
lines.en: I fall, and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水灌进我，什么也没有出来。
lines.en: Water pours into me and nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 爆响之后，我还站在原地。
lines.en: After the blast, I am still standing here.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在后面的墙上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the wall behind.

lines.zh: 那道术光让我退了半步。
lines.en: That spell-light pushes me back half a step.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是越来越淡。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only grow fainter.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮了一切，也照亮了我。
lines.en: The lightning lights everything, including me.
I fall away, and the footsteps remain.
